title: Critically Low Remaining Useful Life
guidance: Prioritize immediate inspection of the engine and review recent telemetry before continued operation.
recommended_actions: Inspect the engine condition immediately.
Review the latest telemetry window.
Check for corroborating sensor degradation.
Schedule maintenance before continued operation.

title: High Telemetry Anomaly Rate
guidance: A high proportion of recent telemetry differs from the learned healthy baseline and should be investigated.
recommended_actions: Review the latest anomalous cycles.
Compare telemetry against the healthy baseline.
Investigate whether multiple sensors show correlated deviation.
Inspect the engine if anomalies persist.

title: Critical Sensor Deviation
guidance: One or more monitored sensors have moved substantially away from their learned healthy operating baseline.
recommended_actions: Identify the sensors with the largest baseline deviation.
Check whether the sensor trend is increasing or decreasing.
Compare related sensor behaviour for corroboration.
Investigate the physical subsystem represented by the affected sensor.

title: Multiple Sensor Degradation Signals
guidance: Multiple sensors deviating from their healthy baseline provide stronger evidence that the observed condition should be investigated.
recommended_actions: Review the highest-deviation sensors together.
Look for consistent trend directions across related signals.
Compare the current telemetry window with the healthy baseline.
Escalate for engineering inspection when multiple critical signals persist.

title: Increasing Sensor Trend
guidance: An increasing sensor trend indicates that the monitored signal is moving upward over the recent observation window.
recommended_actions: Review the recent sensor trajectory.
Compare the current trend against the healthy baseline.
Check whether other sensors show related movement.
Continue close condition monitoring.

title: Decreasing Sensor Trend
guidance: A decreasing sensor trend indicates that the monitored signal is moving downward over the recent observation window.
recommended_actions: Review the recent sensor trajectory.
Compare the current trend against the healthy baseline.
Check for correlated changes in related sensors.
Continue close condition monitoring.
